results.title: Aravali Express Assault Case: Thane Model Allegedly Attacks RPF Staff With Razor Over Reserved AC Seat, Released On Bail
results.description: Thane-based model Antara Soham Banerjee, 31, was arrested after allegedly attacking RPF personnel with a razor aboard the Aravali Express following a dispute over a reserved AC seat.
